text_block_list.text:
“—Today is Valentine's Day. Yet for some 
reason...”

There seemed to be approximately one 
Umamusume who mistook it for Halloween.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Zephyr! Gimme chocolate, chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
If you don't give me chocolate, I'll have 
to play a trick on you! So, gimme some!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, oh, Turbo-san... That's certainly... 
a troublesome personality trait.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Here, take this. I was just thinking of 
giving it to you anyway.

The one who demanded chocolate was Yamanin 
Zephyr. A peer from the same generation, 
she is a horse girl like the wind who 
thrives on the sprint circuits.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
“Still, are you sure about this, 
Turbo-san? Just receiving chocolates from 
others, that is.”

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind of one's feelings does not blow 
in only one direction. Gifting chocolate 
in return is also a lovely custom, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Thank-you chocolate...? That sounds like a 
challenge to Turbo! In that case...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'll make some handmade chocolate for my 
Trainer! And totally surprise them!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Alright Turbo, time to melt the chocolate 
in a hot water bath~. Bubble, bubble, 
bubble~♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: *Simmer, simmer, bubble, boil--!!*

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really sure, but isn't it good to 
go soon? It's pretty much melted!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: No—not yet!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Eeeh, really~? Do you actually have a lot 
of baking experience, by any chance?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"There isn't! But Turbo knows! This 
chocolate can burn way, way hotter!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"So let's burn it all up! Turn the stove 
heat up high, too... Turbo full 
throttle—!"
(Fwoooosh!!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Eeeeh, the flames are literally going all 
the way around the pot, though!? Don't try 
this at home, kids!?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It simmers way better like this! Yes, yes, 
let's keep it right here!

"And in the afternoon— I was summoned by 
Twin Turbo."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer! As a token of my daily gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Here, I'll give you this chocolate! Give 
it a try!

An unexpected present. I happily tear open 
the wrapping. And then...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hm? Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's not charcoal~! It's chocolate that 
Turbo made by pushing herself to the 
absolute limit, so...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's guaranteed to be ruthlessly 
delicious. You'll understand once you try 
it!

Having no choice after being told to, I 
take a bite... Just as expected, it tasted 
completely overcooked...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
From the look on your face, is it not very 
tasty? Then Turbo will take a bite too...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: (Munch, munch, munch...)

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Ueeeh, Turbo tried her very best... 
Whyyyy?

Sports and baking require entirely 
different skills. Still, if it served as a 
good experience for Twin Turbo, that's 
what matters most.
choice_data_list:
Let's eat it all together till the very 
end!

text_block_list.text:
"Sharing this bitterness is also a fine 
experience..."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Turbo doesn't want this. I'm gonna shove 
it all into Trainer's pockets.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Uuuugh, Trainerrr. Turbo needs a palate 
cleanser, I wanna eat some yummy 
chocolate, I wanna eat it, I really wanna 
eat ittt!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Colorful marble chocolates. Yep, ya 
can't beat these!

...I ended up buying her chocolate at the 
convenience store. In the end, Twin Turbo 
spent a Valentine's Day only on the 
receiving end.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
So, burn it all out down to the very last 
ember...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hooold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh, Palmer? What's up?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I know you want to see it through 
thoroughly, but overthinking it won't do 
any good.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna go all out, the design's the 
way to go. That'll definitely boost the 
recipient's vibes!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, design, huh... Well, if Palmer says 
so, we've gotta do it.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's do our best with the 
shaping. Just like a high-end Uma-Pla!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, that might be for the best~.

"And in the afternoon— I was summoned by 
Twin Turbo."

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Trainer! As a token of my daily gratitude!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Here, I'll give you this chocolate! Give 
it a try!

An unexpected present. I happily tear open 
the wrapping. And then...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
What do you think!? It's Turbo's special 
colorful car chocolates!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The hull is yellow banana chocolate. The 
windows are pink strawberry chocolate. And 
the ocean around it is blueberry 
chocolate!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
It's delicious no matter where you bite 
into it!

"It was crafted so perfectly... that it 
felt like a waste to eat it. And as I 
looked at it..."

I imagined a yellow sports car pleasantly 
cruising along the beach...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, what do you think? It's the perfect 
Valentine's, right?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Hm? Was there something strange?

The only thing that caught my eye... was 
the writing on the chocolate. It said—
"Thanks-car!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Huh, was I wrong?
choice_data_list: No, in a sense, that's accurate.
No, in a sense, you're right.

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it was meant as a pun. Since it 
was a car-shaped chocolate, 'car-dial 
thanks' wasn't entirely wrong.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, eat up, eat up! And then give a 
little bit to Turbo too!

And so, the two of them joyfully ate away, 
getting chocolate all around their mouths 
in the process.
